title: Spinach and Spinanza Keto Scramble
description: A delicious and healthy keto breakfast recipe made with spinach, spinanza, and a few simple ingredients.
instructions: 1. In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add the spinach and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
3. Add the spinanza and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt and pepper.
5. Pour the eggs over the spinach and spinanza mixture in the skillet.
6. Use a spatula to gently scramble the eggs and combine with the spinach and spinanza.
7. Cook for another 2-3 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked through.
8. Serve hot and garnish with additional spinach if desired.
